FHIR-43351 later refined only the extension definition prose, while HTA-147 and UP-623 added external IANA Time Zone Database metadata in THO/UTG outside core. Current rendered R5/build pages show a 469-concept expansion and no stale 'not currently used' or 'I A N A' text.
